profiles.name: Mas Ermieyati Samsudin
profiles.position: Chair of the Public Accounts Committee; Member of the Dewan Rakyat
profiles.description: Mas Ermieyati Samsudin represents Masjid Tanah, Melaka, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Chair of the Public Accounts Committee; Member of the Dewan Rakyat. A Parti Wawasan Negara member.
profiles.affiliation_note: The October report identifies her as Wawasan women’s chief. This supersedes the August report that she was aligned with the party but had not yet joined; attendance at the June launch alone was not used to infer membership.

profiles.name: Adly Zahari
profiles.description: Adly Zahari represents Alor Gajah, Melaka, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Deputy Minister of Defence. A AMANAH member.

profiles.name: Bakri Jamaluddin
profiles.description: Bakri Jamaluddin represents Tangga Batu, Melaka, in the Dewan Rakyat. A PAS member.

milestones.title: Build 40 new veteran homes and repair 280 homes in the 2026 programme
milestones.description: Adly announced JHEV’s RM8 million programme, with quotations followed by hoped-for construction and repairs from March or April.
milestones.progress_note: The primary report is dated 15 January. Prior-year approvals are not 2026 completions. The 2026 programme uses a year-end target marker; a complete comparable delivery total was not verified.

milestones.title: Hand over a new home under the veterans’ housing initiative in Jasin
milestones.description: The Defence Ministry records Adly officiating the handover of a newly built home under the Armed Forces veterans’ housing initiative.
milestones.progress_note: A dated 2025 handover, not proof of the separate 2026 national 40-new-home target. Delivery is shared with JHEV and the implementing agencies.

methodology: Dated public commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. An evidence-only record has no invented earlier promise. Status is tied to its evidence snapshot and shared agency responsibility is explicit. Historical activity is not a live November performance measurement. Allocations, attendance, sales orders and unrelated programme ratios are not completion percentages. Additional research may extend this initial pass.
